issues.body: Section 8 says all seventeen workflow bindings read `${{ secrets.ALERT_REPO || vars.ALERT_REPO || '' }}`. The tree has 17 `ALERT_REPO:` bindings, but only 16 use that expression; `.github/workflows/groom.yml:607` uses `${{ secrets.ALERT_REPO }}` without the variable fallback. This does not undermine the document's main analysis, but it makes the deployment-configuration caveat imprecise.
issues.fix_hint: Say that 16 bindings use the secret/variable fallback expression and one is secret-only, or describe all 17 more generally as reading an `ALERT_REPO` workflow binding.
issues.title: The claimed 17 identical ALERT_REPO bindings include one different binding

verdict.summary: The research-only change is substantively correct and complete for its stated purpose. The checkout supports the central inventory (11 `_alert_route` definitions plus `model-health.py`'s split route), the five materially different shapes, the absent shared module, the two single-file sparse checkouts, and the missing route assertions in `park-stock-alert.py`. It changes no runtime or trust-plane behavior. One minor counting/wording error remains in the final caveats: there are 17 `ALERT_REPO` workflow bindings, but only 16 use the expression quoted there; the remaining binding is secret-only.
